opening.argument: The presentation is an instructional guide to communicating with an AliExpress seller and gathering information before creating an order. It states that “The main goal is to collect all necessary information about the selected seller or product at the preliminary stage of creating the order,” while directing viewers to use the shop or order page contact form and discuss matters such as discounts and shipping dates. It also expressly cautions that “It is not recommended to make any order, especially to pay an order of such a seller” when the seller does not respond. This is practical guidance for evaluating a seller through ordinary commerce-platform tools, not a solicitation for money or credentials.

citations.quote: How to communicate with the seller on aliexpress.com
The main goal is to collect all necessary information about the selected seller or product at the preliminary stage of creating the order.
It is not recommended to make any order, especially to pay an order of such a seller.
At the shop or order page click Contact now Fill in the form that appears on the plate. Confirm information here and click Send.
